IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Friday 13 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots becoming variable about 10 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: Around 1 metre, decreasing below 0.5 metres around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming west to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the early morning. Winds reaching up to 30 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Sunday 15 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 30 knots turning southwesterly during the morning.
Seas: 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres, increasing to 3 to 4 metres during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail.
